name: entry_dispatch_then_idle_loop

description: Entry point that shares its decompiled body with the routine before it, calling a table routine to get an object and clearing a field of it. It then runs the same endless loop of table calls.

name: dispatch_object_name_then_exit
description: Calls a table routine to get an object and returns early if none is returned. Otherwise it runs table routines on indexed fields, copies a string from the object into a global buffer, sets a status word to a fixed value and tail-dispatches through the table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:0150
name: select_object_copy_name
description: Calls a table routine to select an object, and when it is found it stores two indexed values and calls further table routines. It copies a string from the object into a global buffer, sets the same fixed status word and tail-dispatches through the table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:01E4
name: dispatch_indexed_handler_or_cleanup
description: Calls a table routine and, when its masked result is nonzero, stores an index and calls the handler at that index. Otherwise it runs the same cleanup path, copying a string into the global buffer and tail-dispatching through the table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:0230
name: dispatch_handler_returning_result
description: Calls a table routine and, when its masked result is nonzero, stores an index and invokes the handler it selects, returning that handler's result. A zero result runs the cleanup path and tail-dispatches through the table, returning its result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:02DE
name: poll_then_dispatch_result
description: Repeatedly calls a table routine until it returns a nonzero value with the top bit clear, then calls the handler at the index it gives. A zero handler result returns zero; otherwise it runs the cleanup path, copies a string into the global buffer and tail-dispatches, returning that result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:02E2
name: poll_then_dispatch_with_status
description: Repeatedly calls a table routine until a nonzero index comes back, then calls the handler it selects and returns zero when that handler fails. On success it runs the cleanup path, copies a string into the global buffer and tail-dispatches through the table, returning its result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:038A
name: store_state_copy_input_name
description: Stores its input word as a state value, runs the cleanup path that clears the pending field and tests the object's flags, then copies a zero-terminated string from the input pointer into the global buffer. key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:038E
name: store_state_copy_name_alt
description: Stores the input word as a state value, performs the same flag-driven cleanup, and copies the zero-terminated string at the input pointer into the global buffer. It sets a fixed status word and tail-dispatches through the table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:0436
name: setup_display_registers_and_palette
description: Fills a table of six entries and writes a sequence of nibble-packed words into a buffer. It then sets the display window, fetch and modulo registers, clears the palette colour registers and copies a block of colour values from a source table into them.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:05F8
name: scan_table_for_value
description: Advances through a table of 16-bit entries until the entry equals the value in the data register, leaving the pointer at that entry. It is a plain linear search with no fallback for a missing value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:0600
name: search_table_for_matching_word
description: Steps through a table of 16-bit words, two bytes at a time, until one matches the value in the data register. The routine has the same body as its neighbour and returns with the pointer on the matching word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:0640
name: locate_matching_table_entry
description: Steps through a table of 16-bit entries, two bytes at a time, until the entry equals the value in the data register. It leaves the pointer on the matching entry and does nothing else.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:f15:0:064C
name: unpack_run_length_rows
description: Decodes a byte-oriented run-length stream: a control byte with its top bit clear copies that many following bytes literally, and a set top bit repeats the next byte the negated count of times. name: entry_then_return_result_word
description: Clears a result word, saves two base pointers, calls two table routines, then calls two more table routines through the saved object. It returns the result word, which only the first step writes.

name: entry_then_return_result_alt
description: Clears a result word, saves two base pointers, calls two table routines, then calls two more table routines through the saved object. It returns the result word, which only the first step writes; the body matches the entry before it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:003A
name: format_signed_decimal_string
description: Converts a signed 32-bit number to decimal text by repeated subtraction against a table of descending powers of ten. It writes a minus sign for negative values, emits the digits and a terminator, then appends the text to the end of the destination string.

name: format_signed_decimal_entry
description: Entry point into the decimal conversion code, sharing its body with the routine before it. It converts a signed 32-bit value by repeated subtraction against descending powers of ten and appends the digits to the destination string.

description: Stores a 32-bit value fetched from a table indexed by the second data register into a frame slot, then copies a zero-terminated string from the source pointer into the destination buffer, terminator included.

name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the source pointer into a fixed destination buffer, including the terminating zero. It does not measure or check the destination length.

name: append_zero_terminated_string
description: Walks to the terminating zero of the destination buffer, then copies the zero-terminated source string onto the end of it, including its terminator.

name: process_nested_text_entry_alt
description: Calls a routine and then reads a string pointer from the input record at a fixed offset. A nonzero first character causes the string to be handed to a routine, followed by a second routine call; the body matches its neighbour.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:0266
name: save_and_replace_handler_slot
description: Saves the 32-bit value at a location reached through a pointer in the state block into a global, then writes a code address into that same location. This swaps a slot in a table for the routine's own address.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:027C
name: restore_saved_handler_slot

name: tick_countdown_and_step_counter
description: Decrements a countdown and, when it goes negative, resets it to one and steps a 12-bit counter by 273, reversing a direction flag when the counter reaches its limits. The decompiled listing ends at an invalid instruction, so the tail of the routine is not shown.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:02BC
name: step_counter_and_flip
description: Adds 273 to a 12-bit counter, toggles a flag when the counter reaches 4095, and stores the counter into a global. The decompiled listing ends at an invalid instruction, so later behaviour is unclear.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:02EA

name: init_object_then_wait_loop
description: Clears two fields and sets a marker byte in a state block, then calls table routines to position and initialise an object from the input block. key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:03B8

description: Performs the same object setup and per-item placement loop as its shorter neighbour, with a larger body that adds more table calls and per-item scaling of coordinates. It waits on flag bytes, writes five fixed-position entries through the table, and returns after a final table call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:1228
name: run_object_setup_entry_one
description: Entry point into the object setup and item placement loop shared with its neighbours. It clears fields in the state block, positions an object from the input block through table calls, then waits on flag bytes and writes five fixed-position entries before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:18E0

name: run_object_setup_entry_three
description: Enters the shared object setup routine at a later point, with the same decompiled body as its neighbours. It places items through table calls, waits on flag bytes and finishes with the fixed-position table writes.

name: run_object_setup_entry_four
description: Enters the shared object setup routine near its end, with the same decompiled body as the entries before it. It performs the final table calls, waits on flag bytes and returns after the fixed-position writes.

name: run_object_setup_entry_five
description: Entry point into the shared object setup loop that first makes one table call and then runs the same placement loop. It waits on flag bytes and writes the five fixed-position entries through the table before returning.

description: Reads the next item record from a list, unpacking its fields from consecutive bytes. key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:22AE
name: apply_item_flag_bits
description: Calls two table routines, then tests the top two flag bits of the current item code and calls a table routine for each set bit. It finishes by pointing a global at its own data cell.

name: conditional_flag_dispatch_stub
description: Calls a table routine when bit 6 of the input value is set, then makes one further routine call and points a global at its own data cell. It is a short routine with no loop.

description: Calls three routines, makes one table call, then calls a further routine and points a global at its own data cell. It has no loop and no return value.

name: call_table_pair_then_helper
description: Makes two table calls, calls a routine, and points a global at its own data cell. It is a short sequence with no branches.

name: select_table_call_by_mode
description: Returns zero when a state field is clear, otherwise checks a mode field against two fixed values and makes a table call on the matching path. It then clears a global and returns the result of a final routine call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:23F8
name: dispatch_mode_then_set_marker
description: Makes a table call, then picks one of three identical table-call paths depending on a mode field compared with two fixed values. It sets a global marker to all ones and calls a routine before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2422
name: dispatch_on_mode_value
description: Compares a mode field against one fixed value and makes a table call on either branch, both of which point a global at its own data cell. It then sets a global marker to all ones and calls a routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:243E
name: table_call_then_set_marker
description: Makes a table call, points a global at its own data cell, sets a global marker to all ones and calls a routine. It is a short sequence with no branches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:245C
name: table_call_then_clear_pointer
description: Makes a table call and then clears the global pointer to zero. It is a two-step routine with no branches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:246C
name: run_helpers_then_set_pointer
description: Calls two routines, makes one table call, calls a further routine and points a global at its own data cell. It has no branches and no return value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:24AA
name: add_to_accumulator_and_refresh
description: Adds the input word to a running accumulator, then makes two table calls to refresh the object it works on. It has no branches and no return value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:24CE
name: sum_handler_results_over_records
description: Resets a set of counters, then walks a list of three-byte records. For each record whose low two bits are zero it calls the table handler indexed by the low six bits and adds the handler's result to a running total; the decompiled loop shows no exit condition, so the listing is incomplete.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:25E6
name: compute_scaled_result_by_flags
description: Returns one of several values made by multiplying a shared scale value by 20, 25, 100 or 200, chosen by flag bits in the input and by a table byte. Each path also increments one of several counters.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2614
name: return_scaled_hundred
description: Returns a shared scale value multiplied by 100. It is a three-instruction routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2620
name: return_scaled_25_flag_sign
description: Increments a counter and returns the shared scale value multiplied by 25, with its low word negated when the table flag mask for the current entry is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2650
name: return_scaled_25_and_count
description: Increments a counter and returns the shared scale value multiplied by 25. The decompiled output shows no other effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2662
name: return_scaled_20_table_flag
description: Returns the shared scale value multiplied by 20 and increments one counter when the table byte's low two bits are clear. Otherwise it increments a second counter and returns a negated pair built from the same product.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:26A8
name: count_and_return_negated_20
description: Increments a counter and returns the shared scale value multiplied by 20 as a negated pair of words. It is a short routine with no branches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:26BE
name: return_scaled_50_with_counter
description: Increments a counter and returns the shared value plus one multiplied by 50. When a table comparison holds it instead increments a second counter and returns the same product as a negated pair of words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2704
name: return_scaled_50_and_count
description: Increments a counter and returns the shared value plus one multiplied by 50. It has no branches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2722
name: count_and_return_zero
description: Increments a counter and returns zero. It is a three-instruction routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2732
name: draw_blitter_line_between_points
description: Returns early when the new point equals the stored one. Otherwise it scales both coordinates by 224 and 210 then divides by 255, computes absolute deltas and selects an octant code from a table, then waits for the blitter and programs its line-drawing registers over four rows of the bitplane.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2736
name: draw_blitter_line_entry_one
description: Entry point into the blitter line-drawing routine shared with its neighbours. It returns early when the new point equals the stored one, otherwise it scales the coordinates, computes deltas and an octant code, then programs the blitter's line registers over four rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:273A
name: draw_blitter_line_entry_two
description: Starts at a second entry into the same blitter line-drawing body as its neighbours, so the listing is identical. It scales the point, computes absolute deltas and selects an octant, then drives four rows of blitter line registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:273E
name: draw_blitter_line_entry_three
description: Enters the shared blitter line-drawing code at a third point, with the same decompiled body as its neighbours. It computes the scaled deltas and octant, then programs the blitter for four rows of the line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2742
name: draw_blitter_line_entry_four
description: Enters the shared blitter line-drawing code at a fourth point, with the same body as the entries before it. It skips when the point has not moved, otherwise computes the line's deltas and runs the blitter over four rows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:274C
name: draw_blitter_line_wide_entry
description: Blitter line routine variant that takes its coordinates as full words and keeps the low sixteen bits of each. It scales both points, computes absolute deltas and an octant code, then drives the blitter over four rows of the line.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:286E
name: save_background_and_draw_block
description: Clamps two inputs to fixed ranges and computes two bitplane addresses from them. For 40 rows it saves the words at one address into a backup buffer and writes fifteen source words into the other, sets a state byte to all ones, and advances both pointers by 200 bytes per row.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2962
name: restore_background_block
description: Copies 40 rows of fifteen 16-bit words from a backup buffer back into a bitplane, advancing 200 bytes per row. It is the inverse of the routine that saves that block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:29C0
name: setup_blitter_copy_for_block
description: Waits for the blitter to finish, sets its source and destination pointers to two bitplane addresses offset by a fixed amount, and sets twelve-byte modulo values. It selects plain copy mode with full masks and starts a blit of a fixed size.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:2FB4
name: update_progress_and_flags
description: Raises a stored maximum to the current value, then branches on a state code. Codes 130 and 131 set a flag bit and make a series of table calls, while code 1 advances a counter and makes the same calls once its low bits reach a threshold. It also compares two stored thresholds against the current value and, when one is crossed, sets a flag bit and makes table calls.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:3464
name: update_progress_and_flags_entry
description: Entry point into the progress and flag update routine with the same decompiled body as its neighbour. It raises the stored maximum, branches on the state code, and makes table calls and flag updates when the thresholds are reached.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:360A
name: call_two_routines
description: Makes two routine calls and returns. It is a minimal wrapper with no other effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:360E
name: call_two_routines_alt
description: Makes two routine calls and returns, with the same body as its neighbour. It has no other effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:3644
name: call_two_routines_second
description: Makes two routine calls and returns, sharing its decompiled body with the wrappers around it. No other effect is shown.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:367A
name: draw_string_with_fixed_origin
description: Clears a field, calls a routine with the fixed arguments 167, 319 and 110 twice, then sets the field to 31. It calls a table routine once per character of the string at the source pointer, advancing the vertical argument by 12 each step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:368C
name: draw_string_with_register_origin
description: Sets a field from a register input, calls a routine with the three register arguments, then restores the field. It calls a table routine once per character of the string at the source pointer, advancing the vertical argument by 12 each step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:36BC
name: draw_string_stepped_by_twelve
description: Calls a table routine once per character of the string at the source pointer, passing the register arguments and advancing the vertical argument by 12 each step. It has no other effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:CF4C
name: copy_state_block_into_buffers
description: Copies a run of state words into a fixed buffer, then copies a block of 50 four-byte records and a further table block into separate areas. The copying is broad and the decompiled listing is truncated before the end.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:CFFC
name: refresh_state_when_value_changed
description: Returns early when a state value equals the value stored last time. Otherwise it records the new value and calls a table routine to look up a record, and the decompiled listing is truncated before the copy that follows.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:D0CE
name: load_record_into_state_block
description: Calls a table routine to obtain a record, then copies its header words into state fields and copies its trailing records into the state block. It then fills a lookup area from an offset table; the decompiled listing is truncated.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:end:0:D250
name: set_global_marker_full
description: Sets a global byte to all ones and returns. It is a one-instruction routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:0000
name: run_main_routine_with_counter
description: Initialises state fields, runs a table update, and returns all ones when a decrementing counter goes negative. Otherwise it clears a blitter region, waits on flag bytes, looks up an entry from a stored value, runs table routines in sequence, zeroes a block of state words and returns a counter value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:0006
name: copy_large_buffer_bump_values
description: Copies about 137,000 bytes from a fixed source into the buffer pointed to by the state block. When a state flag is set it then adds two to one byte in each of 26 pointed-to cells.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:219C6
name: run_main_routine_alt
description: Enters the same main routine as its neighbour with an identical decompiled body. It initialises state, runs table updates, waits on flags and returns a counter value, or all ones when the counter is exhausted.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:219F0
name: copy_string_into_fixed_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the source pointer into a fixed buffer, including the terminating zero. It does not check the buffer length.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:21A14
name: format_signed_number_with_commas
description: Converts a signed 16-bit value to decimal text, writing a minus sign for negatives and comma separators between thousands groups. It then appends the text to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:21AA2
name: format_three_digits_and_append
description: Stores a longword from a table selected by the second data register, then writes the hundreds, tens and units of a 16-bit value as ASCII digits into fixed cells. It appends the zero-terminated text at the source pointer to the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:21AE6
name: format_signed_long_decimal_text
description: Converts a signed 32-bit value to decimal text by repeated subtraction against descending powers of ten, writing a minus sign for negative values. It then appends the digits to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:21B50
name: format_digit_run_and_append
description: Writes a run of ASCII digits, each found by repeated subtraction against a table of place values, into the destination buffer. It then appends the zero-terminated string from the source pointer to the end of the destination.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:21B64
name: format_digit_counts_and_append
description: Produces a run of ASCII digit characters by counting how many times each table value fits into the input, storing one character per entry. It terminates the run and appends the zero-terminated text at the source pointer to the destination.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:21B76
name: run_main_routine_b
description: Enters the same main routine as the earlier select-file entries, with an identical decompiled body. It initialises state, runs table updates, waits on flag bytes and returns a counter value, or all ones when the counter is exhausted.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:22204
name: draw_string_entry_register_args
description: Entry point into the string drawing routine that sets a field from the register input, calls a routine with the register arguments and restores the field. It then calls a table routine once per character, advancing the vertical argument by 12 each step.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:22208
name: draw_string_from_register_args
description: Draws the string at the source pointer by calling a table routine once per character with the register arguments, advancing the vertical argument by 12 each step. Its body is the same as the entry before it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:22238
name: step_string_draw_calls
description: Calls a table routine once per character of the string at the source pointer, stepping the vertical argument by 12 each time. It is a short loop with no other effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:2224E
name: decay_nibble_fields_table
description: Runs six passes over a table of 24 words, decrementing the three nibble fields of each word by one step per pass and copying each updated word into a global buffer. It sets a global to a fixed value and returns the low nibble of the last word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:26682
name: run_input_state_loop
description: Repeatedly sets four flag bytes to all ones and calls a table routine, steps a 12-bit counter by 273 with a direction flag like the earlier counter, and moves a state index through a lookup table according to the flag bytes. It exits when its tested conditions hold, then stores the state index and copies a value through a pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:267E6
name: store_state_index_copy_value
description: Stores the current state index into the state block and copies a longword, selected by that index from a lookup table, into the location a pointer in the state block points to. It is the exit path of the input state loop.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:select:0:26870
name: reset_five_state_words
description: Clears four state words and sets two other state words to all ones. It is a short initialisation with no branches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0000
name: run_game_entry_main_routine
description: Program entry for the game file. It stores its base pointers, sets a flag byte, fills a 128-byte table with a fixed value, calls table routines to set up state and then loops, updating a timer from 1000 minus a stored value, until a flag is set. It finishes by clearing a block of values and returns a result word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0006
name: run_game_main_routine_handler
description: Handler entry into the game main routine, sharing its decompiled body with the program entry before it. It sets up state, calls table routines, updates a timer from 1000 minus a stored value, and returns a result word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:01FC
name: set_word_if_flag_clear
description: When a stored flag word is zero, sets a second stored word to all ones; otherwise it leaves that word unchanged. It is a one-branch routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:020E
name: add_eight_to_strided_bytes
description: Adds eight to one byte in each of 89 cells spaced eight bytes apart, starting from the global buffer. It has no branches beyond the loop.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0226
name: initialise_game_state_fields
description: Sets several state fields to fixed values and clears three strided tables of words. It rebases a set of pointers by adding a base address, resets flag bytes, and sets a handler type and timer when a state value equals four.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:05DC
name: initialise_object_slot_records
description: When a state value is zero, or a second flag is set, initialises a counted series of slot records: sets flag bits and fixed sizes, derives positions from base values and a handler pointer, and then fills one further record with fixed values and a handler pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:072C
name: save_replace_handler_slot_b
description: Saves the 32-bit value at a location reached through a pointer in the state block into a global, then writes a code address into that location. It has the same effect as its sibling that swaps a table slot.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0742
name: restore_saved_handler_slot_b
description: Writes the saved global value back to the location reached through the state block pointer, undoing the earlier slot replacement.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0750
name: update_frame_and_display_registers
description: Advances a countdown index through a lookup table, and when a state field is zero it also records a timing delta and increments a counter. When another state field is nonzero it copies saved values into the palette and display registers, sets the display window, fetch and modulo registers from fixed values, and stores two further words. The decompiled listing ends at an invalid instruction, so the tail is incomplete.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:07AC
name: update_display_registers_from_state
description: Records a timing delta and increments a counter when a state field reaches 50. When a state field is nonzero it copies saved values into the palette and display registers and sets the display window, fetch and modulo registers. The decompiled listing ends at an invalid instruction.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:085E
name: write_fixed_display_control_words
description: Stores four fixed 16-bit values into offsets of a state block, then ends at an invalid instruction. The decompiled listing is therefore incomplete.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:087C
name: store_four_values_via_pointers
description: Writes four stored words through four pointers held in the state block, copying each value from its matching slot. It has no branches.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:08AE
name: rebase_two_offset_tables
description: Sets two bits in a byte at the caller's pointer, then adds a base address to each entry of two tables of longwords, using counts taken from stored values to control the loops.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:08D2
name: rebase_two_offset_tables_b
description: Adds a base address to each entry of two longword tables, with counts from stored values controlling the loops. It is the same as its sibling without the initial flag change.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:08F8
name: dispatch_active_slots
description: Clears two state words, then walks four slots spaced 24 bytes apart and calls a routine for each whose first word is nonzero. It then calls a handler through a stored pointer for each of the next two slots that are nonzero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0936
name: find_nearest_record_and_update
description: Scans records spaced 86 bytes apart for the nearest one whose flag bits match, keeping the smallest distance. If none matches, it advances a counter, updates position and velocity from table-scaled values, decrements a countdown and returns zero or minus one. If one matches it stores that record's fields in the state block and returns a slot index.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:09BA
name: store_slot_fields_when_idle
description: Calls a routine and, when it returns zero, makes five more routine calls and stores three record words into a global slot. The slot is selected from a counter taken from the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A0E
name: update_object_position_and_timer
description: Advances a counter, scales the object's velocity by table values and a speed term, updates its two position words and decrements its countdown. It returns zero or minus one depending on a routine result and the sign of the countdown.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A20
name: update_object_or_retarget
description: When a target field is negative it searches a table of slots for the nearest candidate and stores it as the target. It then reduces a value, advances a counter, updates position and countdown as its neighbour does, and returns zero, or minus one at expiry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A6E
name: store_slot_fields_after_check
description: Calls a routine and, when it returns nonzero, calls a second routine; if that returns zero it makes five routine calls and stores three record words into a global slot. Otherwise it returns with no effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0A78
name: update_object_or_store_slot
description: Calls a routine and, when it returns nonzero, runs the same position and countdown update as its neighbours. A zero result leads through routine calls that store three record words into a global slot, with a clamped range test on the way.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0AB0
name: store_slot_fields_when_clear
description: Calls a routine and, when it returns zero, makes five more routine calls and stores three record words into a global slot. It is a short conditional store with no other effect.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B0A
name: step_toward_target_in_range
description: Moves a position toward a target by a clamped step derived from the difference, then updates a second axis using table-scaled steps. It returns minus one when the object is within range of the target and zero otherwise.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B1C
name: step_toward_target_range_b
description: Moves a position toward a target by a clamped step from the register difference, then updates a second axis by table-scaled steps. It returns minus one when the object is within range and zero otherwise; the body matches its neighbour that takes its inputs from the state block.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B58
name: check_range_on_hit
description: Updates one axis by a table-scaled step, then returns minus one when the object is within range of the target and zero otherwise. It has no other state changes.
